protocol.cache_manifest_policy: metadata-only; avoids deliberately paging artifact contents into memory before measurement
protocol.checker: batch Lean only (daemon bypassed; serialized root and missing-import processes)
protocol.escape_hatch_policy: every measured subject must have zero warnings, defers, and assumes
protocol.lean_import_workers: exactly one by required LEAN_IMPORT_WORKERS=1 inherited by direct run_lean
protocol.lean_task_manager: disabled by required LEAN_NUM_THREADS=0 inherited by direct run_lean
protocol.metric: end-to-end verification API wall time, including front end, VC generation, Lean emission/check, and artifact publication
protocol.orchestration_conventions: SABLE_TEST_JOBS=1 pins the supported outer verification pool; the serial timing loop does not consume it
protocol.profile_identity: exact Cargo output profile directory captured from OUT_DIR at compile time and cross-checked against the running test executable path
protocol.subject_serialization: one lexicographic Rust loop; no subject worker pool
protocol.warm_lineage_limit: authenticates selected cold-report bytes and equivalent path/type/size cache state, not temporal adjacency, unique physical lineage, or cache-content identity beyond normal content-addressed artifact validation
